title: siphocampylus lamarckii var. tuerckheimii

This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including inflammation and fever, due to its numerous health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Siphocampylus lamarckii var. tuerckheimii include anti-inflammatory, antipyretic, and antimicrobial effects, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes. However, more research is needed to confirm the exact bioactive constituents and their effects on human health.
